# Google Business Profile Help
> Help center documentation for managing and troubleshooting Google Business Profile listings and business information on Google.

Google Business Profile Help provides official guidance for creating, verifying, updating, and maintaining business profiles that appear on Google Search and Maps. It includes setup instructions, policy information, troubleshooting steps, and management guidance for owners and administrators.

## Getting Started
- [Google Business Profile Help Home](https://support.google.com/business/): Main help center for Google Business Profile setup, management, and troubleshooting.
- [Manage your Business Profile directly on Google](https://support.google.com/business/answer/145585): Explains how to access and manage a profile from Google Search and Maps.
- [Sign up for Business Profile](https://support.google.com/business/answer/2911778): Shows how to create a new Business Profile for a business.
- [Add or claim your business on Google](https://support.google.com/business/answer/2911778): Guidance for adding a new listing or claiming an existing one.
- [Find your Business Profile](https://support.google.com/business/answer/145585): Describes where to locate and open profile management tools.

## Verification and Ownership
- [Verify your business on Google](https://support.google.com/business/answer/7107242): Overview of available verification methods and verification requirements.
- [Fix verification issues](https://support.google.com/business/answer/4569145): Troubleshooting steps when verification fails or is delayed.
- [Request ownership of a Business Profile](https://support.google.com/business/answer/4566671): Explains how to request access to a profile owned by someone else.
- [Transfer primary ownership of a Business Profile](https://support.google.com/business/answer/3415281): Steps for changing the primary owner of a profile.
- [Add and remove owners and managers for your Business Profile](https://support.google.com/business/answer/3403100): Describes user roles and how to manage profile access.

## Edit Business Information
- [Edit your Business Profile on Google](https://support.google.com/business/answer/3039617): How to update business name, category, address, and hours.
- [Add or edit your business address for your Business Profile](https://support.google.com/business/answer/2853879): Guidance for setting or changing a storefront address.
- [Set your service area on Google](https://support.google.com/business/answer/9157481): Explains service-area business configuration and coverage settings.
- [Update business hours on Google](https://support.google.com/business/answer/6303076): How to set regular, holiday, and special hours.
- [Add or edit your phone number for your Business Profile](https://support.google.com/business/answer/9594086): Instructions for updating contact phone information.
- [Add or edit your website on your Business Profile](https://support.google.com/business/answer/3038177): Shows how to add or change the website URL.

## Profiles on Google Search and Maps
- [How your business information appears on Google](https://support.google.com/business/answer/3038177): Overview of how profile details surface across Google properties.
- [Business Profile on Google Search](https://support.google.com/business/answer/145585): Managing profile features directly in Search.
- [Business Profile on Google Maps](https://support.google.com/business/answer/145585): Managing and viewing profile information in Maps.
- [Understand local ranking on Google](https://support.google.com/business/answer/7091): Explains relevance, distance, and prominence in local results.
- [Fix missing or incorrect business info on Google](https://support.google.com/business/answer/3038177): Steps to correct profile data issues.

## Reviews and Customer Engagement
- [Read and reply to reviews on Google](https://support.google.com/business/answer/3474122): How to monitor customer reviews and post owner responses.
- [Get more Google reviews from customers](https://support.google.com/business/answer/3474122): Guidance related to collecting reviews within Google policies.
- [Report inappropriate reviews on your Business Profile](https://support.google.com/business/answer/4596773): Steps for flagging policy-violating customer reviews.
- [Manage customer messages for your Business Profile](https://support.google.com/business/answer/6398699): Explains messaging features and message management.
- [Manage bookings through your Business Profile](https://support.google.com/business/answer/9450811): Information about booking integrations and appointment features.

## Photos, Posts, and Content
- [Add photos or videos to your Business Profile](https://support.google.com/business/answer/6103862): How to upload visual content to a business listing.
- [Photo and video guidelines for Business Profiles](https://support.google.com/business/answer/6103862): Requirements and best practices for profile media.
- [Create posts for your Business Profile on Google](https://support.google.com/business/answer/7342169): How to publish updates, offers, and event posts.
- [Edit or delete posts on your Business Profile](https://support.google.com/business/answer/7342169): Manage existing posts and remove outdated content.
- [Add products to your Business Profile](https://support.google.com/business/answer/9900814): Shows how to feature products in a profile.
- [Add services to your Business Profile](https://support.google.com/business/answer/9450811): Guidance for listing services offered by the business.

## Performance and Insights
- [Understand Business Profile performance](https://support.google.com/business/answer/7689763): Overview of metrics available for profile visibility and engagement.
- [See how customers find your Business Profile](https://support.google.com/business/answer/7689763): Explains discovery and search-related performance data.
- [Track calls, website clicks, and direction requests](https://support.google.com/business/answer/7689763): Describes customer action metrics in performance reporting.
- [Understand photo performance on your Business Profile](https://support.google.com/business/answer/7689763): Information about media-related engagement insights.

## Policies and Eligibility
- [Guidelines for representing your business on Google](https://support.google.com/business/answer/3038177): Core eligibility and representation rules for Business Profiles.
- [Business Profile content policies](https://support.google.com/business/answer/3038177): Policy guidance for names, categories, and profile content.
- [Address guidelines for Business Profiles](https://support.google.com/business/answer/9157481): Rules for storefront and service-area address usage.
- [Chain and department guidelines](https://support.google.com/business/answer/3038177): Requirements for multi-location brands and in-store departments.
- [Hotel Business Profile policies](https://support.google.com/business/answer/3038177): Specialized policy considerations for hotel listings.

## Troubleshooting and Support
- [Fix suspended or disabled Business Profiles](https://support.google.com/business/answer/4569145): Help for profiles that are suspended, disabled, or restricted.
- [Appeal a suspended Business Profile](https://support.google.com/business/answer/4569145): Steps to request reinstatement after a suspension.
- [Fix duplicate Business Profiles](https://support.google.com/business/answer/4566671): Guidance for resolving duplicate or conflicting listings.
- [Fix missing reviews or missing profile content](https://support.google.com/business/answer/3474122): Troubleshooting for absent reviews, posts, or profile elements.
- [Contact Google Business Profile support](https://support.google.com/business/gethelp): Entry point for official support and issue resolution.
